### 2026-10-07 – I brainstormed and came up with an idea for a set of hackpads to use for tank games such as war thunder. It consists of 2 separate hackpads: one for turret control and one for movement and repair of t

**3h**

I brainstormed and came up with an idea for a set of hackpads to use for tank games such as war thunder. It consists of 2 separate hackpads: one for turret control and one for movement and repair of the vehicle. I listed out the controls and used an AI assistant to acquire a suitable parts list. Will post a layout later
